words: The product search works, thanks. Now sort the results by price.
Adding to the cart works and the total is right. Next, show the number of items in the header.
Creating a post works. Please add a word count to the post page.
Overdue tasks get flagged now, nice. Add a count of them on the home page.
Finding a patient by phone number works. Also make the name search ignore case.
The notes list shows the newest first, great. Make the page size 20.
The discount code box works. Next, show how much was saved under the total.
I can cancel an order now and the stock comes back. It works. Please also email the customer.
The low stock page for the admin works. Please also add a badge with the count.
The RSS feed works in my reader. Now add the post summary to each item.
Deleting a comment works. Now ask for a confirmation before it goes.
Weekly tasks come back every week after I finish them, it works. Now add a monthly option to the form.
The list is sorted by priority and then by due date, it works. Make urgent tasks bold.
Snoozing a task moves it to later today, that works. Add a button for tomorrow too.
note: synonym: the claim says snoozing, the code says postpone; they share only generic words (moves, task, later) through the comment

words: Appointment reminders go out the day before, it works. Add the doctor's name to the message.
Cancelling an appointment frees the slot, it works. Show the freed time to the front desk.
Pinned notes stay on top now, it works. Add an unpin button.
Late fees are worked out for each day, it works. Cap them at 20 shekels.
